title: 第一卷 第4章 木屋升级
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

石头的方向，只有一个丧尸。

秦龙不假思索，直接朝着这个丧尸冲了过去。

在接近丧尸的时候，原地一个滑铲，从丧尸恶臭的身子下面滑了过去。

接着身体以一个惊人的角度弹起。

手中石斧狠狠的朝着丧尸的后脑勺砍了下去。

提示音传来，秦龙知道自己的手。

丧尸掉落的东西瞬间装入空间，随后头也不回的朝着大石头冲了过去。

脚尖一点，秦龙已经跳到了石头的中间，手指精确的抓在了一块凸起之上。

借着这股力量，直接翻身而上，来到了石头的上面。

而身后的那些七个丧尸，此时也都已经离大石头不到几米的距离。

但凡要是慢上两三秒，今天估计就得被逼的进去木屋了。

现在嘛！

看着石头下面无力嘶吼的丧尸，这不就是菜吗？

可惜自己刚才跑的太匆忙了，没有折一根棍子之类的。

现在丧尸是够不到自己，但自己也够不着丧尸的脑袋。

看了一下空间。

刚才杀的那个丧尸，给自己又爆了一年的寿元.

除了寿元，貌似还有一根长长的东西。

拿出来一看，好家伙，竟然是一根长木棍子。

连铁制武器都不是，就是一根单纯的木质棍子。

只不过表面打磨的很是光滑，也算是比较结实！

至少自己能够打得到这些丧尸了。

居高临下，感觉有点像是打地鼠！

几棍子下去，丧尸的脑袋就像是爆西瓜一样的爆开。

地上东西掉了一地，尸体也横七竖八倒了一地。

最后一只丧尸，甚至直接被棍子给捅穿了脑袋。

貌似杀丧尸，捅穿比打爆更加顺畅一点。

看着满地的东西和丧尸尸体。

秦龙内心窃喜，有时候借助地形什么的，要比直接莽上去容易多了。

今天这个局面，要是自己没有借助这个大石头。

要么就是被逼到木屋里面，木屋拥有奇特的能力，除了主人，别的东西打不开，要么就是直接毁了木屋！

要么就是直接莽上去。

运气好点，无伤杀完，运气差点，被咬上一口什么的，基本就跟全民求生说拜拜了。

略微休息了一下，观察了一下周围没有新的丧尸出现。

秦龙跳下了这个大石头。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the direction of the stone, there is only one zombie.

Qin Long rushed towards the zombie without thinking.

When approaching the zombie, a sliding shovel slipped under the zombie's stinking body.

Then the body bounced up at an amazing angle.

The stone ax in his hand struck hard at the back of the zombie's head.

The prompt sound came, and Qin Long knew what he had in hand.

The things dropped by the zombies were instantly loaded into the space, and then they rushed towards the big rocks without looking back.

With a little tip of his toes, Qin Long had jumped into the middle of the stone, and his fingers accurately grasped a bulge.

With this power, he turned directly up and came to the top of the stone.

The seven zombies behind him were now less than a few meters away from the big rock.

If he had been slower than two or three seconds, he would have been forced into the cabin today.

Now!

Looking at the zombies roaring powerlessly under the stone, isn't this just food?

It's a pity that I ran in a hurry just now and didn't break a stick or anything like that.

Now the zombies can't reach him, but he can't reach the zombie's head either.

I looked at the space.

The zombie I just killed gave me another year of life.

In addition to Shouyuan, there seems to be a long thing.

When I took it out, I saw that it was actually a long wooden stick.

It's not even an iron weapon, just a simple wooden stick.

It’s just that the surface is polished very smooth, and it’s relatively strong!

At least I can defeat these zombies.

Being condescending, it feels a bit like whack-a-mole!

After a few sticks, the zombie's head exploded like a watermelon.

Things fell all over the floor, and bodies lay scattered on the ground.

The last zombie was even stabbed through the head with a stick.

It seems that killing zombies is smoother by piercing them than by blowing them up.

Looking at the things and zombie corpses all over the ground.

Qin Long was secretly happy. Sometimes it was much easier to use terrain or something like that than to rush straight up.

In today's situation, if I didn't have the help of this big rock.

Either he is forced into the wooden house, which has a strange ability that cannot be opened by anyone except the owner, or the wooden house is destroyed directly!

Or just go ahead and do it.

If you're lucky, you'll kill him without any injuries, but if you're not lucky, you'll get bitten or something, and you'll basically say goodbye to national survival.

I took a short rest and observed that no new zombies appeared around me.

Qin Long jumped off the big stone.
